result.summary: Found several visual issues, mainly a visible localization key and some horizontally clipped content that makes the page look unfinished.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing translation/string mapping so this section shows the intended label, such as "Popular near you" or similar.

issues.description: The category filter row is cut off on the right, showing only part of the next pill without any label.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal scroll behavior, padding, or a fade indicator so the clipped chip looks intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the "Fastest near you" carousel is heavily clipped at the right edge, including its image and text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have consistent spacing and enough visible preview area, or add a clear scroll affordance/fade so partial cards look intentional.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card content/image area, making the feed look abruptly cut off at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the height of the bottom navigation so cards are not hidden behind it.
